```{r wgcna-me-heat-plot, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$wgcna_out)}
me_gt <- params$wgcna_out$module_eigengene_heatmap$gtable
me_w <- min(grid::convertWidth(sum(me_gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), 8)
me_h <- min(grid::convertHeight(sum(me_gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE), 8)
# Width -25%, height +20% vs previous 5.25 x 3.5 display footprint.
disp_w <- 3.94
disp_h <- 4.2
dpi <- 150
pixelratio <- dpi / 72
css_w <- as.integer(round(me_w * 72))
css_h <- as.integer(round(me_h * 72))
display_w <- as.integer(round(disp_w * dpi))
display_h <- as.integer(round(disp_h * dpi))
me_content <- htmltools::plotTag({
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(me_gt)
}, alt = "wgcna_module_eigengene_heatmap", width = css_w, height = css_h, pixelratio = pixelratio,
   suppressSize = "xy",
   attribs = list(
     width = display_w, height = display_h,
     style = sprintf("max-width: none !important; width: %dpx; height: %dpx;", display_w, display_h)
   ))
me_buttons <- list(
  deseq2reports::download_grid_plot_button(params$wgcna_out$module_eigengene_heatmap, filename = "wgcna_module_eigengene_heatmap", width = me_w, height = me_h),
  deseq2reports::link_output_file("wgcna_module_eigengenes.csv", label = "Download eigengenes CSV")
)
deseq2reports::emit_widget(deseq2reports::wrap_with_corner_button(me_content, me_buttons))
```

```{r wgcna-modules-split, include=FALSE}
wgcna_collections <- if (!is.null(params$wgcna_out)) names(params$wgcna_out$ora_by_module) else character(0)
# Cap modules shown in the HTML: embedding a DT + plot for every module x
# collection blows memory when WGCNA finds dozens of modules. Full
# per-module CSVs/PDFs remain on disk. Pipeline-side max_modules
# (default 15) already tries to merge down to an optimal count.
max_modules_html <- 15L
safe_file_tag <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
wgcna_hub_modules <- character(0)
wgcna_ora_modules <- character(0)
wgcna_modules_truncated <- FALSE
if (!is.null(params$wgcna_out)) {
  sizes <- sort(table(params$wgcna_out$module_df$module), decreasing = TRUE)
  sizes <- sizes[names(sizes) != "Unassigned"]
  ranked <- names(sizes)
  hub_all <- intersect(ranked, names(params$wgcna_out$hub_genes))
  ora_all <- Reduce(union, lapply(wgcna_collections, function(coll) {
    names(params$wgcna_out$ora_by_module[[coll]])
  }))
  ora_all <- intersect(ranked, ora_all)
  if (length(hub_all) > max_modules_html) {
    wgcna_hub_modules <- hub_all[seq_len(max_modules_html)]
    wgcna_modules_truncated <- TRUE
  } else {
    wgcna_hub_modules <- hub_all
  }
  if (length(ora_all) > max_modules_html) {
    wgcna_ora_modules <- ora_all[seq_len(max_modules_html)]
    wgcna_modules_truncated <- TRUE
  } else {
    wgcna_ora_modules <- ora_all
  }
}
```

```{r wgcna-hub-intro, results='asis', eval=length(wgcna_hub_modules) > 0}
cat("\n\n### Module genes\n\n")
cat("\n\nAll genes assigned to each co-expression module, sorted by absolute ",
    "module membership (|kME|). Each table includes the full module membership ",
    "and shows the top 10 by default. Use the tabs below to show **one module ",
    "table at a time**. Download the CSV for the active module. The ",
    "\"Unassigned\" module (WGCNA's \"grey\" catch-all) is omitted here because it ",
    "has no coherent expression profile.\n\n", sep = "")
if (isTRUE(wgcna_modules_truncated)) {
  cat("Showing the **", length(wgcna_hub_modules),
      "** largest modules in this page (full membership CSVs for every module ",
      "are written next to the other WGCNA outputs).\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r wgcna-hub-loop, results='asis', eval=length(wgcna_hub_modules) > 0}
# Bootstrap tabs written into the HTML (not rmarkdown `{.tabset}` JS), so
# they are visible even on very large self-contained pages.
gene_col <- setdiff(colnames(params$wgcna_out$module_df),
                    c("module", "module_label", "module_color", "kME"))[1]
pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start("wgcna-module-genes", wgcna_hub_modules)
for (i in seq_along(wgcna_hub_modules)) {
  mod <- wgcna_hub_modules[i]
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))

  mod_df <- params$wgcna_out$module_df
  mod_df <- mod_df[mod_df$module == mod, , drop = FALSE]
  keep <- c(gene_col, "kME")
  keep <- keep[keep %in% colnames(mod_df)]
  mod_df <- mod_df[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  if ("kME" %in% colnames(mod_df)) {
    mod_df <- mod_df[order(-abs(mod_df$kME)), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  rownames(mod_df) <- NULL

  if (nrow(mod_df) > 0) {
    cat("<p>All <strong>", nrow(mod_df),
        "</strong> module genes sorted by |kME|; table shows the top 50 ",
        "(full membership via the CSV link).</p>\n", sep = "")
    mod_show <- utils::head(mod_df, 50L)
    dt <- deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(mod_show, page_length = 10)
    dt$x$options$scrollY <- "360px"
    dt$x$options$scrollCollapse <- TRUE
    dt$sizingPolicy$filler <- FALSE
    btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
      file.path(safe_file_tag(mod), "hub_genes.csv"),
      label = "Download hub genes CSV"
    )
    # Full module membership is in wgcna_modules.csv (filtered by reader).
    btn2 <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
      "wgcna_modules.csv",
      label = "Download all modules CSV"
    )
    deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(dt, list(btn, btn2), center = FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("<p>No genes for this module.</p>\n")
  }
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
}
deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
# Redraw DataTables when a hidden tab becomes visible.
cat("<script>$(document).on('shown.bs.tab', 'a[data-toggle=\"tab\"]', function () { if (window.HTMLWidgets) HTMLWidgets.staticRender(); if (window.jQuery && $.fn.dataTable) { $($.fn.dataTable.tables(true)).DataTable().columns.adjust(); } });</script>\n")
```

```{r wgcna-ppi-split, include=FALSE}
wgcna_ppi_modules <- character(0)
if (!is.null(params$ppi_out) && !is.null(params$ppi_out$by_module) &&
    length(params$ppi_out$by_module) > 0) {
  # Only real WGCNA modules (never LRT degPatterns cluster keys that may
  # also live in ppi_out$by_module under run_deseq2_lrt()).
  ppi_names <- names(params$ppi_out$by_module)
  if (length(wgcna_hub_modules)) {
    wgcna_ppi_modules <- intersect(wgcna_hub_modules, ppi_names)
  } else if (!is.null(params$wgcna_out$module_df)) {
    real_mods <- setdiff(unique(as.character(params$wgcna_out$module_df$module)),
                         "Unassigned")
    wgcna_ppi_modules <- utils::head(intersect(real_mods, ppi_names), max_modules_html)
  }
}
```

```{r wgcna-ppi-intro, results='asis', eval=length(wgcna_ppi_modules) > 0}
cat("\n\n### Module PPI connectivity\n\n")
cat("\n\nSTRING protein-interaction subgraph among each module's member genes ",
    "(ranked by |kME|). BioNERO-style layout: Louvain communities, degree-sized ",
    "nodes; **hover any node** for its gene name. Top hubs stay labelled. ",
    "Module genes with no STRING edge to another member are omitted. ",
    "Use the tabs to show one module network at a time.\n\n", sep = "")
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce module PPI connectivity with this package module:",
  "ppi_out <- run_ppi_pipeline(",
  "  diffexp_out = diffexp_out, wgcna_out = wgcna_out",
  ")"
)
```

```{r wgcna-ppi-loop, results='asis', eval=length(wgcna_ppi_modules) > 0}
pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start("wgcna-module-ppi", wgcna_ppi_modules)
for (i in seq_along(wgcna_ppi_modules)) {
  mod <- wgcna_ppi_modules[i]
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))
  ppi <- params$ppi_out$by_module[[mod]]
  if (!is.null(ppi) && !is.null(ppi$plot)) {
    n_mapped <- if (!is.null(ppi$n_mapped)) ppi$n_mapped else NA_integer_
    cat("<p><strong>Gene filter funnel:</strong> ",
        ppi$n_seed, " module seeds → ",
        if (!is.na(n_mapped)) paste0(n_mapped, " mapped to STRING → ") else "",
        ppi$n_with_edge, " with ≥1 STRING edge among members",
        if (!is.null(ppi$max_plot_nodes) && ppi$n_with_edge > ppi$n_plotted) {
          paste0(" → top ", ppi$n_plotted, " by degree plotted (cap ",
                 ppi$max_plot_nodes, ")")
        } else {
          paste0(" → ", ppi$n_plotted, " plotted")
        },
        ". Top ", length(ppi$hubs), " hubs labelled.</p>\n", sep = "")
    # Static embed (interactive PPI x many modules blows HTML memory).
    deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
      ppi$plot,
      filename = paste0(safe_file_tag(mod), "_ppi_connectivity"),
      width = 6.5, height = 5.5
    )
    hub_df <- ppi$nodes
    if (!is.null(hub_df) && nrow(hub_df)) {
      hub_df <- hub_df[order(-hub_df$degree, hub_df$gene), , drop = FALSE]
      rownames(hub_df) <- NULL
      cat("<p><strong>Genes by connectivity (degree).</strong> ",
          "All ", nrow(hub_df), " module genes with ≥1 STRING edge among ",
          "members, ranked by degree (plot may show a degree-capped subset). ",
          "Top 50 shown in the table; ", sum(hub_df$hub, na.rm = TRUE),
          " plot-labelled hubs have <code>hub = TRUE</code>.</p>\n", sep = "")
      hub_show <- utils::head(hub_df, 50L)
      hub_btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path("..", "ppi", safe_file_tag(mod), "ppi_hubs.csv"),
        label = "Download full hubs CSV"
      )
      deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
        deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(hub_show, page_length = 10),
        hub_btn, center = FALSE
      )
    }
  } else {
    cat("<p>No STRING edges among genes in this module.</p>\n")
  }
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
}
deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
```

```{r wgcna-ora-intro, results='asis', eval=length(wgcna_collections) > 0}
cat("\n\n### Per-module pathway enrichment\n\n")
cat("\n\nOver-representation analysis (`fgsea::fora()`) of each co-expression module's ",
    "genes against every requested MSigDB collection (same collections as GSEA). ",
    "Outer tabs select the module; inner tabs select the collection (same layout as ",
    "pathway enrichment). The \"grey\"/Unassigned module is excluded throughout.\n\n", sep = "")
deseq2reports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Per-module ORA is included in the WGCNA module call above:",
  "wgcna_out <- run_wgcna_pipeline(dds_qc, var = \"condition\")",
  "# results: wgcna_out$ora_by_module[[collection]][[module]]"
)
if (isTRUE(wgcna_modules_truncated)) {
  cat("Showing the **", length(wgcna_ora_modules),
      "** largest modules in this page; per-module ORA CSVs/PDFs for all modules ",
      "remain on disk.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
```{r wgcna-modules-loop, results='asis', eval=length(wgcna_collections) > 0}
# Nested Bootstrap tabs: module -> collection (static HTML, like GSEA UX).
ora_plot_h <- 4 * 0.8
mod_pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start("wgcna-ora-modules", wgcna_ora_modules)
for (mi in seq_along(wgcna_ora_modules)) {
  mod <- wgcna_ora_modules[mi]
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(mod_pane_ids[mi], active = (mi == 1L))

  coll_pane_ids <- deseq2reports::bs_tabset_start(
    paste0("wgcna-ora-", safe_file_tag(mod)), wgcna_collections
  )
  for (ci in seq_along(wgcna_collections)) {
    coll <- wgcna_collections[ci]
    deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_start(coll_pane_ids[ci], active = (ci == 1L))

    p_ora <- params$wgcna_out$ora_plots_by_module[[coll]][[mod]]
    ora_df <- params$wgcna_out$ora_by_module[[coll]][[mod]]
    if (!is.null(ora_df) && nrow(ora_df) > 0) {
      p_ora <- tryCatch(
        deseq2reports::plot_module_ora_dotplot(ora_df, top_n = 10, title = paste0("Module: ", mod)),
        error = function(e) p_ora
      )
    }
    if (!is.null(p_ora)) {
      deseq2reports::emit_plot_with_download(
        p_ora,
        filename = paste(safe_file_tag(mod), coll, "ora_dotplot", sep = "_"),
        width = 5.25, height = ora_plot_h, dpi = 120
      )
    }
    if (!is.null(ora_df) && nrow(ora_df) > 0) {
      ora_show <- utils::head(ora_df[order(ora_df$padj), , drop = FALSE], 50L)
      ora_btn <- deseq2reports::link_output_file(
        file.path(safe_file_tag(mod), paste0("ora_", coll, ".csv")),
        label = "Download full ORA CSV"
      )
      deseq2reports::emit_widget_with_download(
        deseq2reports::make_gsea_datatable(ora_show), ora_btn, center = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      cat("<p>No significantly enriched ", coll, " gene sets for this module.</p>\n", sep = "")
    }
    deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
  }
  deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
  deseq2reports::bs_tab_pane_end()
}
deseq2reports::bs_tabset_end()
```
